title_en: Fall 2026 Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project): Third Interim Presentation
summary: Students taking the Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) in Fall 2026 must attend the third interim presentation on Thursday, 5 November, at 18:30 in the classroom assigned to their module. Each student's module and further notices have been sent to the email address written on the submitted meeting confirmation form. Attendance is taken exactly at the start time, and any expected absence must be reported to the person in charge in advance, not on the day.
applies_to: Students taking the Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) in Fall 2026. Attendance at the third interim presentation is expected; unexcused lateness or absence is to be avoided.

dates.what: Third interim presentation of the Graduation Project (attendance checked exactly at the start time)
Deadline to report an expected absence (e.g. reserve forces training or an academic conference) to the person in charge: before the presentation day; notice on the day is not accepted

conditions: Attendance is checked exactly at the start time (18:30), so arriving late counts as lateness.
Unexcused lateness and absence must be avoided.
If you cannot attend for a reason such as reserve forces training or an academic conference, you must inform the person in charge in advance.
Notification of absence on the day of the presentation is not accepted.
If you did not receive the email notice with your module, you must inform the person in charge.
steps: Check the email address you wrote on your submitted meeting confirmation form (면담확인서) for the notice and your assigned module.
If you did not receive the email, inform the person in charge (contact details are in the original notice).
If you wrote a non-SNU address (for example a Naver account) and wish to change it to your SNU account, tell the person in charge by email.
If you cannot attend because of reserve forces training, an academic conference or a similar reason, inform the person in charge before the presentation day.

On Thursday, 5 November, go to your module's classroom (Semiconductor 1: Room 202; Semiconductor 2: Room 818; Electrical Energy: Room 103; Electrophysics: Room 104; Communications: Room 201; Control: Room 302; Computer 1: Room 102; Computer 2: Room 118; Bio: Room 106) and be present before 18:30 for the attendance check.
translation:
[Fall 2026] Graduation Project (Electrical Engineering Design Project) Third Interim Presentation

The third interim presentation of the Graduation Project will be held on Thursday, 5 November.

The notice and your assigned module have been sent to the email address you wrote on your submitted meeting confirmation form (면담확인서). Please check that email. If you did not receive the email notice, be sure to inform the person in charge (name and email address are in the original notice).

If you wrote a Naver or other email account and wish to change the address to your SNU account, please let us know by email.

Attendance will be checked exactly at the start time, so please take care not to be late or absent without excuse. (If you have difficulty attending because of reserve forces training, an academic conference or a similar reason, please inform me in advance. Notification on the day is not accepted.)

<Teaching assistant in charge and classroom for each module>
